title: Intrinsic finite-quotient module constructibility under inverse image
statement: Let g:S -> T be a morphism of Noetherian schemes, d an adic coefficient datum and n a nonnegative index for the positive quotient A/I^(n+1). If a module over the actual finite function coefficient ring on T becomes intrinsically constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] after restriction along pbcLevelConstantComparison, then its exact quotient module inverse image under g has the same property on S. No derived object, support interval, completeness or direct image occurs.

proof.text: Pull the finite constructible locally closed partition back along g, using fibre products of its immersions. Base change of the trivializing pro-etale covering sieve is covering. The inverse-image composition isomorphism identifies restrictions to the new strata with successive inverse images of the old restrictions. Inverse image of each constant module is the constant module with the same finite value. The constant-section normalized coefficient square, obtained by cancellation in completedFiniteCoefficientMap, identifies quotient-linear pullback followed by restriction with constant-ring pullback. Transport the finite local trivializations through these isomorphisms. The partition retains its positive number of strata, including empty strata and the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem pbc_finite_pullback_constructibility
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian T] (g : S ⟶ T)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (n : ℕ)
    (F : pbcModules T ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n)))
    (h : @IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf T (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) _
      (d.quotientFinite n) ((pbcRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison T d n).hom).obj F)) :
    @IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf S (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) _
      (d.quotientFinite n) ((pbcRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison S d n).hom).obj
        ((proEtaleRingModulePullback g ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n))
          ((pbcAdicRings S d).obj (op n)) (asIso (completedFiniteCoefficientMap g d n))).obj
            F))
